v4_additions.notes: Version 4 keeps the version 3 topology and nullable current_as_of date. Health observations and uncontracted candidate research are additive. The authenticated desk must accept 4 without dropping those fields or requiring candidate rows to appear in source_contracts.json. Desk overlay must keep the version 4 maintainer-architecture lede in its known intro set.

v5_additions.notes: Version 5 keeps the version 4 topology, counts and source fields. It adds the private repair-observation projection: structured source and join conditions carried on this backstage artifact so the authenticated desk can inspect them without reading resident copy. Records are keyed by a stable fingerprint over source, scope and condition only, so a repeated observation or a presentation-copy change resolves to the same record. Only the 'repair' disposition is engineering work; 'expected-absence' and 'source-policy-limitation' record that a state was evaluated and must never be presented as a defect or as a claim against a publisher. The consumer must accept 5 without dropping these fields and must not project any of them onto a public response.
